text: Computer vision is a field of artificial intelligence that helps computers understand images and videos. One important task is image recognition, which allows a computer to identify what is in a picture, such as a person, an animal, or an object. Another key task is object detection, which means finding and locating things within an image. Computer vision has many useful applications in our daily lives. For example, it is used in security systems, medical imaging, and shopping apps. One of the most exciting applications is self-driving cars. These vehicles use computer vision to see the road, recognise traffic signs, and detect other cars and people, helping them drive safely.
